signingPolicy: Same persistent APKbox development key must be used for differential upgrade/rollback tests.
selectionRule: Resolve stableRef at validation time; keep pinnedCheckpointSha as the last explicitly reviewed checkpoint until stable is deliberately promoted.
rollbackRule: Rebuild or retrieve the exact stable candidate, verify SHA/package/signer, then use the narrowest safe install/rollback path. Never silently uninstall across a signature conflict.
